# iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority (Resource)

This resource can manage the configurable AP tag source priorities (`ap tag-source-priority <2-3> source <filter|ap>`), which decide whether AP filters or the AP itself (PnP) take precedence. Priorities 0 (static), 1 (location) and 4 (default) are fixed by the device and cannot be managed. The device rejects any single change that assigns one source to two priorities at once, so swapping the sources of priorities 2 and 3 is applied in two steps (the priority whose source changes is removed first, then both priorities are written). The device needs both priorities to hold a source and each source to be used once, so a priority or a source may appear only once in `priorities` (checked at plan time), and when only one of the two priorities is configured, the other one is written with the remaining source (for example, configuring only 2 = `tag-source-ap-pnp` also writes 3 = `tag-source-filter`). Configure both priorities to make the complete table explicit. If the second step fails, the provider attempts to restore the previous table and reports whether it succeeded. Destroying this resource restores the factory order (2 = `tag-source-filter`, 3 = `tag-source-ap-pnp`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority" "example" {
  priorities = [
    {
      priority = 2
      source   = "tag-source-ap-pnp"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `priorities` (Attributes List) Priority for tag source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--priorities))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--priorities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `priorities`

Required:

- `priority` (Number) Priority for tag source
  - Range: `2`-`3`
- `source` (String) tag source
  - Choices: `tag-source-filter`, `tag-source-ap-pnp`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_ap_tag_source_priority.example ""
```
